question: How are the Atharva and Sāma Vedas embodied as parts of the deity receiving obeisance?
premises: The deity is addressed as having the Atharva Veda as head.
The deity is addressed as having the Sāma Veda as mouth.
Obeisance is offered to these Vedic embodiments.
inference: The deity is honored as embodying the Atharva and Sāma Vedas as bodily parts.
plain_english: Obeisance to the one whose head is the Atharva Veda; obeisance to the one whose mouth is the Sāma Veda.
